theme: Dark Mode Industrial Hardware Showroom / Mission-Control Tech Interface
design_principles: Industrial Showroom + Mission Tech Interface: Pure dark canvas (#0A0B0E) anchored by high-contrast off-white text and precision engineering lines.
Single Kinetic Color Accent: Pure Electric Green (#00E676 / #10B981) reserved exclusively for active states, selection progress, HUD status indicators, and primary CTAs.
Editorial Layout over Generic Cards: High density, thin hairline borders (border-white/10), status readouts in JetBrains Mono, and edge-to-edge masked photography.
Motion Hierarchy: Signature 1.5s kinetic hero activation, scroll-linked brand manifesto text lighting, holographic mouse tilt on featured equipment, interactive radar HUD scanner.

headings.family: Big Shoulders Display, Barlow Condensed, sans-serif
headings.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-[0.95]
headings.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight leading-[1.05]

grids_and_layouts.hero_grid: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 items-center min-h-[90vh] py-16
grids_and_layouts.selector_hud_col: lg:col-span-5 sticky top-28 bg-[#0E1015] border border-white/10 p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-lg
grids_and_layouts.machines_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8

visual_enhancers.radar_scanner: relative overflow-hidden border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-950/10 rounded-lg p-6
visual_enhancers.hairline_divider: w-full h-[1px] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/15 to-transparent my-8
visual_enhancers.glow_button: relative overflow-hidden bg-[#00E676] text-black font-bold uppercase text-xs tracking-widest px-6 py-3.5 transition-all hover:bg-[#00FF75] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,230,118,0.5)] active:scale-[0.98]

key_components.name: HeaderNav
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with blurred dark glass, MAQSYMA SVG mark, nav links, live status indicator 'ATENCIÓN COMERCIAL DISPONIBLE', and request quote modal button.

key_components.name: HeroSection
key_components.description: Signature activation sequence (~1.5s reveal), system boot progress bar (000%-100%), technical process summary strip, primary & secondary CTAs.

key_components.name: BrandManifestoScroll
key_components.description: Scroll-linked text illumination component where 48-word manifesto lights up word-by-word with green accent highlights, plus sticky progress bar with 4 engineering milestones.

key_components.name: CategoryShowcase
key_components.description: Editorial hover-reveal breakdown of MMA, MIG/MAG, TIG, Corte Plasma, Multiproceso, and Accesorios with interactive previews and technical specs.

key_components.name: FeaturedMachines
key_components.description: Grid of 6 heavy industrial machines with technical badges, availability indicators, interactive spec modal, quote trigger, and cursor holographic light reflection.

key_components.name: InteractiveEquipmentSelector
key_components.description: Dual-column matrix (60% listing / 40% HUD scanner). Radar sweep background, instant state updates for MMA, MIG/MAG, TIG, Plasma, Multiproceso.

key_components.name: IndustrialApplications
key_components.description: Full-width parallax grid showcasing real-world deployment in mining, structural steel, manufacturing, and heavy construction.

key_components.name: TechnicalInfoHUD
key_components.description: Command-center specs display rendered in JetBrains Mono with live simulated parameters (Output 500A, Duty Cycle 60%, Input 380V 3PH).

key_components.name: QuoteContactModal
key_components.description: Interactive quotation modal & footer contact system linked directly to WhatsApp +51957082739 (https://wa.me/51957082739) with character scramble entrance effect.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, cards, modal triggers, and tabs MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-quote', data-testid='nav-link-machines', data-testid='selector-tab-mig').
